overview.description: The Volatility Shares 2x Bitcoin ETF (BITX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long btc, short usd currency. The fund aims to provide 2x the daily price movements of an index based on rolling front-month CME bitcoin futures. BITX was launched on Jun 27, 2023 and is issued by Volatility Shares.
